mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (3-month change) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness and impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: A declining year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflation, reducing real interest rates and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1600 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is below 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth and rise in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening amid labor weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines by at least 0.5% and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized above 3.0%) signals sustained economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth (annualized) exceeds 3.0%.
